name: @adaptive-compact/dsh-artifact-store
comment: Compiled distributable of packages/artifact-store, packaged the same way packaging/adaptive-compact/ packages compaction-adaptive: the workspace package.json's main/exports point at src/*.ts on purpose (this repo's own tests run it live via tsx), which Node's --experimental-strip-types refuses to load once it sits under a real node_modules/ tree (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING) -- a real production failure this bundle exists to avoid. See scripts/check-packaging-sync.mjs and docs/11-review-log.md.
